# Twinthos

> Twinthos is a UK managed AI-employee company. It runs a digital employee for small businesses: it handles routine admin and follow-ups, logs every step, and returns time to the owner.

## Pages
- [Home](https://twinthos.com/): what Twinthos does
- [How it works](https://twinthos.com/how-it-works/): the service process
- [Pricing](https://twinthos.com/pricing/): plans and fees
- [Security](https://twinthos.com/security/): data handling
- [FAQ](https://twinthos.com/faq/): common questions
- [Guides](https://twinthos.com/notes/): short sourced pieces on the work

## Guides
- [Small business owners lose 11 hours a week to admin. Here is what that costs.](https://twinthos.com/notes/hours-lost-to-admin/): A July 2026 Amex survey says UK owners spend 11 hours a week on admin. What that costs per year, a calculator for your own week, and how far to trust the number.
- [88 percent of organisations use AI. Almost none run agents at scale.](https://twinthos.com/notes/ai-adoption-gap-2026/): Stanford's 2026 AI Index: 88% of organisations use AI, yet scaled AI agents sit in single digits. The adoption gap, the data behind it and its limits.
- [AI is hitting the first rung of the career ladder first](https://twinthos.com/notes/entry-level-jobs-ai-2026/): Stanford's August 2026 update: workers aged 22 to 25 in AI-exposed jobs are 19% below trend, from fewer hires, not layoffs. What it shows and what it does not.
- [170 million jobs created, 92 million displaced by 2030](https://twinthos.com/notes/wef-jobs-2030/): The WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025 projects 170 million new roles and 92 million displaced by 2030, a net gain of 78 million, and 11 in 100 workers left behind.
- [The horse did not lose to a better horse. It lost to a different job.](https://twinthos.com/notes/horse-population-1915-1960/): US farm horses and mules peaked at 26.7 million in 1918 and fell to about 3 million by 1960. The tractor took four decades, and freed 88 million acres.
